narrative.overview: Every result is a numbered control on an orienteering map's description sheet. The destination is the start triangle, each parking lot is a control with a symbol, and the lot you open is the one the purple course runs to. It refuses the category's white card with a blue button: nothing floats, structure is carried by rules and state by texture and text.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled grid table as the main surface; the list is the product.
Colour is an ink with a single job, and each job has a non-colour backup.
One condensed numeral face for every figure read at a glance.
Flat by default: no shadows, no radius beyond 3px.
Light and dark are the same sheet printed on white and on night paper.

rules.name: The One Course Rule
rules.body: Purple marks the route and nothing else. If two things on a screen are purple, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Ink-With-A-Job Rule
rules.body: Every colour answers one question. A colour that answers none is removed, not recoloured.

rules.name: The No-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: State must survive greyscale: symbol shape, hatch direction, dot screen, or words carry it.

rules.name: The Numerals-Are-Condensed Rule
rules.body: Any figure read at a glance uses the condensed numeral face; running prose never does.

rules.name: The Flat-Sheet Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand out, give it a rule or a texture. A shadow is never the answer.

dos: Do keep purple to the route: start triangle, opened lot, course line, primary action, focus ring.
Do state age next to any count that is older than a few minutes.
Do use hatches and dot screens for state, with words as the backup.
Do keep every control at least 44px tall.
Do verify both light and dark.
donts: Don't put a shadow, gradient, glass or rounded card anywhere.
Don't show "no data" as zero, or a stale reading as fresh.
Don't use blue for anything but links that leave for an outside map.
Don't add a second accent colour for decoration.
Don't embed a map: Google content must not be combined with a non-Google map.
